description: This file contains helper functions for managing tenant selection state using local storage, including getting, setting, and determining if tenant selection UI is needed. It maintains legacy support while promoting newer methods.

methods.name: getActiveTenantId()
methods.description: Retrieves the active tenant ID from local storage, checking the new key 'activeTenant' first, then falling back to the legacy 'activeTenantId'.

methods.name: setActiveTenantId(tenantId)
methods.description: Sets the active tenant ID in local storage using the key 'activeTenant' and removes the legacy key 'activeTenantId'.

methods.name: needsTenantSelection(tenants)
methods.description: Determines whether the tenant selection UI should be displayed, based on whether an active tenant is set and the number of available tenants.
